purpose: persist R1 fine r-scan seeds + protocol BEFORE any GPU episode so the r grid cannot be tuned after seeing a seed succeed
replan_semantics: after each 32-step prediction execute at most min(r,32) steps, then call the model again
r_forbidden: r>32 (aliases r32; ALIAS_OF_R32 only; never an independent point)
scene_identity_rule: all r on a given seed MUST restore the same physical layout; record scene_fingerprint per seed; if two seeds share a layout, label 'same layout / different sampling' and do not claim cross-layout generalization

counting_rule.strict: info.cookies_in_target (tilt<=15deg) + exact_fill (10 in target, 70 source, 2x5, stable 20) - UNCHANGED
counting_rule.relaxed_diagnostic: footprint inside target AND bottom edge on box floor (<=4mm); upright not required; leaning allowed; stacking not counted; read-only in evaluator

no_mid_run_edit: cannot change a seed's r after seeing that seed succeed; the grid is fixed at this sheet
